q: Rajib ran fast lest he ____ miss the train.
She looks at me as if she ____________ me.
He ran away as though_______
He talks as if he __ mad.
He acted as if he _______ the matter.
If she _____ more time, she would learn to play the piano.
e: এটি second conditional। এতে if-যুক্ত অংশে past indefinite বসে এবং মূল অংশে would, could বা might-এর পরে verb-এর base form আসে। মূল অংশে would learn আছে, তাই শূন্যস্থানে past form had হবে। গঠন: If + past indefinite, subject + would + verb। উদাহরণ: If I had a car, I would drive to work। মনে রাখুন: if-অংশে be verb লাগলে সব পুরুষেই were চলে। Has ও will have যথাক্রমে present ও future, আর having একটি participle, তাই এই কাঠামোয় বসে না।

q: If he had studied harder, he __________ the exam.
He talked as though he ____ all in all here.
Which of the following sentences shows inversion?
o: He hardly goes to the gym.
He does hardly go to the gym.
Hardly does he go to the gym.
Hardly he goes to the gym.
e: Inversion হলো বাক্যে subject ও verb-এর স্বাভাবিক ক্রম উল্টে যাওয়া। Hardly, rarely, seldom, never, barely, scarcely, no sooner, little-জাতীয় negative বা restrictive adverb বাক্যের শুরুতে এলে এটি ঘটে। গঠন: Negative adverb + auxiliary verb + subject + main verb। তাই Hardly does he go to the gym-এ inversion আছে। বাকি তিনটিতে স্বাভাবিক ক্রম বা ভুল গঠন রয়েছে।
